name: Hello RustGIS
description: A starter plugin to copy: commands that report on the map's layers, zoom to the largest one and drop a pin at the map's centre, and a tool that draws bounding boxes.
author: opengeos

commands.label:
Layer
Report

commands.label:

commands.label:
Pin
Center
commands.help: Add a point at the centre of the map to a new Pins layer.

tools.name: Bounding Boxes
tools.summary: Draws the bounding box of each feature, or of the whole layer.

params.label: One box for the whole layer
